summary: Baird Medical Investment Holdings (NASDAQ: BDMD), a PRC-domiciled medical device issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a November 2, 2026 Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter finding its ordinary shares closed below the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, breaching Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Trading continues uninterrupted under BDMD during a 180-day compliance period running to May 3, 2027; regaining a $1.00 close for ten straight business days cures the deficiency, and a further 180-day grace period may be available if other continued-listing standards are met. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch for a reverse split or other cure plan and for any second deficiency notice.
